dialogues.speaker: Reekwind
dialogues.text: I'm responsible for security in this district. Right now, I'm out on patrol... and I'm also looking for something.

dialogues.speaker: Reekwind
dialogues.text: I don't suppose you've seen a Millelith-issue polearm around here, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Reekwind
dialogues.text: This is so strange... It must be around here somewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Reekwind
dialogues.text: *sigh* If any of my squad mates find out, they're gonna give me another annoying nickname, I just know it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How does a soldier manage to lose his weapon?

dialogues.speaker: Reekwind
dialogues.text: Shh... Don't let the sergeant hear. Look, it's not like I did it on purpose, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Reekwind
dialogues.text: Believe it or not, I used to be a bit of a lazy slacker. Didn't care much for my appearance. Then, my squad mates starting calling me Reekwind...

dialogues.speaker: Reekwind
dialogues.text: I managed to whip myself into shape, break the habit of a lifetime and quit being so lazy... But then, the forgetfulness took its place.

dialogues.speaker: Reekwind
dialogues.text: Earlier today, I took a short break at that food stall over there. Kinda zoned out for a bit, and when I snapped back, I looked down and somehow there was a laundry pole in my hand... Not a clue where my Millelith polearm went...

dialogues.speaker: Reekwind
dialogues.text: If my squad mates find out I managed to lose my polearm... Who knows what kind of awful new nickname they'll come up with?

dialogues.speaker: Reekwind
dialogues.text: Alright, well... If you see a polearm around, let me know, will you? I'll pay you for your trouble.
